title: Ootle Payment Gateway
summary: WooCommerce gateway source for Tari Ootle payment sessions and signed webhooks. October 20 review followed the edited original contest post to a new HTTP-only test shop at http://172.105.101.24/shop/ and viewed its Test Product listing. The previous 172.105.4.177 address remained unreachable. The maintainer supplies an Esmeralda stealth-transfer receipt and WordPress screenshots; this review browsed the public shop only, without cart, checkout, wallet or payment actions. The shop is served without HTTPS; use its public browsing view only. This is a community test shop, not an official Tari storefront. README setup and daemon compatibility must be checked before integration.
cardSummary: Add Tari payments to WooCommerce using wallet-daemon payment sessions, signed webhooks and order-status updates.
cardStatus: WordPress plugin · Testnet · HTTP-only test shop
creator: luci666
